title: Show HN: I made a private self-destructing image hosting site in Golang
summary: A junior Go developer created picburn.xyz, a privacy-focused self-destructing image hosting service that allows users to share images with controlled access through time limits and share count restrictions, without requiring sign-up or storing uploads permanently.
problem_solved: Provides a simple, ad-free, and anonymous way to share private images with automatic expiration and access controls.
why_valuable: Offers a privacy-first alternative to cluttered image hosting services with no signup requirements and true self-destructing functionality.
